csv_scope_of_work: The State of Connecticut, Department of Transportation, may be seeking a consultant to provide structural design and bridge load rating services. Perform and/or update load ratings in accordance with Federal and State requirements Review load ratings performed by others for conformance with Federal and State requirements and sound engineering principles. Perform and/or coordinate material testing, strain gauging, etc. Provide Design Services During Construction. Other tasks as required for the completion of Federal Metrics for load rating and load posting. Provide Task Order engineering services for project administration and bridge and structure design for the Department.
